settings.title: How to Use
settings.body: Work into a rich lather with warm water, massage over skin, and rinse. Store on a draining dish between uses.

settings.title: Care & Storage
settings.body: Keep your bar dry between uses on a well-draining soap dish, away from direct streams of water.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.body: Ships to the USA, Netherlands, and Belgium. Because each bar is handmade, slight natural variation is part of the craft.

settings.caution: Caution: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with clear water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of infants without supervision.
